run_metadata.coverage_summary: Tier 1 core government portals were swept via WebSearch across all jurisdictions: Commonwealth (AusTender), NSW (buy.nsw / NSW eTendering), VIC (Buying for Victoria), QLD (QTenders / supply.qld.gov.au), WA (Tenders WA), SA (SA Tenders and Contracts), TAS (Tenders Tasmania), NT (QTOL) and ACT (via AusTender). Verifiable open opportunities with real tender IDs and closing dates on or after the run date were captured for Commonwealth (AusTender ATMs incl. a Health RFT, ANSTO EOI, Defence AACAP, a Federal Court interpreter/translator panel and an RFI), NSW local government (Cootamundra-Gundagai Aquatic & Sports Stadium) and a NSW university (University of Sydney chiller/cooling-tower program). Tier 2 (water corporations, councils via VendorPanel, universities via TenderLink) was sampled; Tier 3 corporate (SAP Business Network / Ariba Discovery) was checked. As on recent runs, NO publicly-advertised corporate RFx was visible without a supplier login, so Tier 3 is recorded at the portal level only in discovered_sources. MAJOR LIMITATION (unchanged from recent runs): the session egress proxy blocked ALL direct WebFetch page loads (EGRESS_BLOCKED for every host tried, including www.tenders.gov.au). Every tender below is therefore captured from web-search result titles/URLs/snippets only; deliverables, requirements, evaluation criteria, contacts, documents and several exact dates/buyers could not be confirmed against the originating notice and remain pending a detail pass in a future run where direct fetching is available.
gaps: WebFetch/egress proxy blocked ALL direct page loads this run (EGRESS_BLOCKED for every host attempted, including www.tenders.gov.au, buy.nsw.gov.au, tenders.vic.gov.au). No tender detail page or attached document could be opened; all fields below derive from web-search snippets only.

Because detail pages were unreachable, deliverables_summary, key_deliverables, requirements, eligibility, evaluation_criteria, documents, contacts and some exact publish/closing times could not be verified from the source notice and are left null/empty; buyer identity for a few AusTender ATMs (RFI 97888, ATM_2026_6066, ATM_2026_6026, RFT 01-2026) could not be confirmed from snippets.

State portals NSW eTendering, Buying for Victoria, QTenders, Tenders WA, SA Tenders, Tenders Tasmania and NT QTOL return JavaScript-rendered listing pages that web search does not index at row level; only opportunities that surfaced in search snippets could be captured. A full sweep of each state's current-tender list is deferred to a run where direct fetching works.

Tier 3 (SAP Business Network / Ariba Discovery and major-buyer portals such as BHP, Woolworths, Coles, Qantas) checked but no publicly-advertised Australian RFx was visible without a supplier login; recorded at portal level in discovered_sources only. No corporate opportunities invented.
Invitation-only corporate/consultancy RFPs (e.g. to Accenture/KPMG/Deloitte) are out of scope and not published; none fabricated.
